messages:
Priya (CS): Quick sync 1: we need a focused enablement drop-in for HelioHealth next Thu. 30m max. Primary goals: finish checklist items, confirm Dedicated capacity cutover plan, and surface any renewal concerns. Who can join as leads?

Ethan: I can lead the checklist and cutover Q&A. Suggest we remove any long live demo — keep a 5-min demo clip if needed.

Jules: Im available but would prefer to take notes and capture tasks. I cant present because Im double-booked earlier in the day.

María: Ill prep the renewal health snapshot (NPS, usage delta, error spikes) and share 3 recommended mitigations. I can also run a quick capacity-readiness check.

Priya (CS): Great. Action items: Ethan = checklist + cutover owner, María = renewal snapshot & mitigations, Jules = notes + task tracker. Can @onboarding-bot create the event and attach the compact agenda? Also set a reminder to send a 2-bullet pre-read to the contact 24h before.

onboarding-bot: Event created: https://cal.example.com/event/5298765432. Agenda added to event description and doc: https://redwood.docs/mini-office-hours-helio.ics. Reminder rule set for 24h pre-event.

Ethan: I added a two-slide checklist summary to the doc and a 3-line cutover checklist. Proposal for run order: roll call (1m), quick clip demo (5m), checklist walkthrough (12m), renewal & risks (7m), actions & owners (5m).

Priya (CS): Love it. Can we keep the checklist focused on "must-fix-before-cutover" items only? Also please ensure the cutover rollback steps are clearly highlighted.

María: Will do. I'll include a one-paragraph "current risk" blurb and label items by priority (P0/P1). Target to post the pre-read by Wednesday 10am so customer has time to scan.

Jules: I'll create the meeting notes page from the template and wire in the task tracker columns: owner, due date, status, escalation needed. I'll also capture actionable follow-ups in linear after notes.

Priya (CS): Perfect. Last ask  can someone from Solutions Eng monitor latency metrics for HelioHealth just before the meeting in case we need to pause cutover discussion? Ethan or SE oncall?

Ethan: I can run a quick check 15m before the meeting and post a short signal in the thread.

Priya (CS): Awesome. Summary of deliverables: 1) onboarding-bot: calendar + agenda + reminder (done). 2) María: pre-read + risk bullets (due Wed 10am). 3) Ethan: finalize checklist slides & cutover rollback steps (due Thu 9am). 4) Jules: notes page & task tracker (create before meeting). 5) Ethan: latency check 15m prior. If anything changes flag here and well reschedule. Thanks all :wave:

(onboarding-bot reaction): :white_check_mark:
